item.title: 评论: 政策红利“落地成景” 海南前10月入境游客同比增43.2%
item.description: 中新网海口11月17日电 (记者 张茜翼)一次免签入境、一单离岛免税购物、一趟医疗康养之旅，正将海南自贸港的政策红利转化为境外游客可感可及的便利。今年1-10月，海南接待入境游客161.97万人次，同比增长43.2%，入境游成为最亮眼增量。

The government of billionaire Prime Minister Andrej Babis wants to switch from funding Czech TV and Czech Radio through licence fees paid by viewers and listeners to payments from the state budget. item.title: 评论: Nato to skip 2027 Albania leaders’ summit as high-level meetings are scaled back
item.description: Nato is scaling back its high-level meetings and will not hold a leaders’ summit in Albania next year as previously planned amid tension within the alliance over defence spending, Iran and the war in Ukraine. Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama said on Thursday that “there is not yet a common position on when the summit will happen, for sure not in 2027”. He said that “in 2028, if it will be a summit, it will be in Tirana”, Albania’s capital. Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte played down the issue....

item.title: 评论: 無法複製的奇蹟？深圳如何從改革開放樣板變為「中國矽谷」
item.description: 深圳首次主辦亞太經濟合作組織（APEC）領導人峰會，成為中國的第三座主辦城市。深圳的崛起往往被視為中國改革開放最成功的一場實驗。而在中國和世界變幻莫測的今天，這個高速發展的奇蹟還能延續嗎？

item.title: 评论: Zelensky warns Starshield restrictions threaten Ukraine’s winter energy defences
item.description: Restrictions on Ukraine’s Starshield satellite communications system are hindering its ability to intercept Russian drones, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Sunday. He warned that limitations on the system, operated by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, could weaken defences around Ukraine’s energy infrastructure ahead of the winter months, when Moscow has repeatedly targeted the power grid. item.title: 评论: Pope Leo visits high Andes, testing recovery from lung cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo on Sunday faced his toughest physical test since undergoing lung cancer surgery, visiting high-altitude Cusco on the final full day of his South America tour. The 71-year-old pontiff, who had part of a lung removed a month ago, arrived in the ancient Inca capital, more than 3,400 metres (11,000ft) above sea level – high enough to leave many a visitor breathless. item.title: 评论: 告别“黑零”时代：德国2027年联邦预算出炉
item.description: 德国联邦议院预算委员敲定2027年联邦预算草案。政府计划支出5610亿欧元，但预算缺口高达1230亿欧元。面对俄乌战争持续、国防开支激增、养老金压力攀升以及基础设施老化等挑战，德国加速告别“黑零”时代。经济学家警告若德国政府不削减支出，明年或面临严重财政危机。
